faqs.question: What are Generative AI development services?
faqs.answer: They cover the design, development, integration, deployment, and monitoring of AI applications that create content, retrieve business knowledge, automate workflows, and support decisions.

faqs.question: What types of Generative AI solutions can businesses build?
faqs.answer: Common solutions include chatbots, copilots, knowledge systems, document tools, content platforms, recommendation engines, multimodal applications, and agents for workflow automation.

faqs.question: How is a custom Generative AI solution different from an off-the-shelf tool?
faqs.answer: A custom solution is built around your workflows, data, integrations, security requirements, and users. An off-the-shelf tool offers more standardized capabilities with less control.

faqs.question: What is retrieval-augmented generation?
faqs.answer: RAG connects a language model to trusted documents and data so it can produce more contextual answers grounded in your organization's information.

faqs.question: Can Generative AI integrate with existing systems?
faqs.answer: Yes. AI applications can connect with CRM, ERP, HR, commerce, cloud, and legacy systems through APIs, middleware, and secure data connectors.

faqs.question: How long does it take to develop a Generative AI application?
faqs.answer: A proof of concept may take a few weeks, while a production-ready application can take several months. The schedule depends on scope, data readiness, integrations, testing, and security needs.

faqs.question: Which industries can use Generative AI?
faqs.answer: Healthcare, finance, retail, manufacturing, logistics, education, travel, real estate, energy, and media can use generative AI for content, analysis, knowledge retrieval, and automation.

faqs.question: How do teams reduce inaccurate AI responses?
faqs.answer: Use verified knowledge sources, RAG, structured prompts, output validation, confidence thresholds, human review, model evaluation, and continuous monitoring.

faqs.question: What happens after an AI solution is deployed?
faqs.answer: Ongoing work can include performance monitoring, prompt improvements, knowledge updates, security reviews, cost tracking, evaluation, and user feedback analysis.

faqs.question: Why choose Kodrise for generative AI development?
faqs.answer: Kodrise combines product design and engineering to build secure, scalable AI around real business needs, supporting discovery, development, integration, deployment, and ongoing improvement.
